To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have identified a novel zinc finger protein gene induced by TNF alpha in human endothelial cell.

the novel gene, EZFIT, encoding a 490 amino acid protein with 13 C2 H2 zinc fingers, is expressed most abundantly in human placenta and is induced more than 19 fold by tumor necrosis factors alpha in human umbilicular vein endothelial cells.

the novel zinc finger protein EZFIT is induced most profoundly among the 155 zinc finger protein genes by tumor necrosis alpha (TNF) in human umbilial vein endothelial cells and that EZFIT is most highly expressed in human placenta followed by brain, testis and pancreas.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the discovery of the novel zinc finger protein, EZFIT, which is most abundantly expressed in the placental tissues.
the identification and characterization of a novel zinc finger protein gene, EZFIT, in human endothelial and other cells.
a novel gene, EZFIT, that encodes a zinc finger protein which is expressed in a tissue-specific manner.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
EZFIT is a novel zinc finger protein which is expressed predominantly in the brain, testes and placenta, but is induced most profoundly in HUVECs stimulated by TNF alpha.
EZFIT is a new member of the zinc finger protein family which is induced most prominently by TNFalpha in endothelial cells.
the EZFIT gene is a novel gene encoding a zinc finger protein and is induced by TNF-alpha in endothelial cells.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the novel gene EZFIT is induced by TNF-alpha and is highly expressed in human endothelial cell.
the EZFIT mRNA is induced by TNF-alpha and that it has the highest expression in the placenta and brain.
the novel zinc finger protein EZFIT is induced by TNF alpha and may play an important role in the endothelial cells.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a novel zinc finger protein, EZFIT, is induced most profoundly among the 155 genes coding for zinc finger proteins in endothelial cells stimulated with TNFalpha.
a new zinc finger protein, EZFIT, which has 13 C2C2 zinc finger motifs, is induced most profoundly in HUVECs by TNFalpha.
a novel zinc finger protein, EZFIT, is expressed in human endothelial and other cells and is induced by TNFα.
